items.question: What is the fine under the UAE Federal Law on Anti-begging for anyone caught begging?
items.fact: Begging fine under UAE anti-begging law is AED 5,000

items.question: What minimum jail term does the UAE Federal Law on Anti-begging set for those operating professional gangs of beggars?
items.gold: A jail term of not less than six months.
items.fact: Gang operators of beggars face minimum six months jail
